findings: The candidate has zero front-right geometric-contact and positive-normal-force samples in all 150 post-prefix native steps; its 24 earlier samples belong to the unchanged prefix. Prepared support remains a separate 0/31 measurement.
No joint-limit constraint occurs in the candidate's 150 post-prefix native samples. The retained command-90 refusal is predictive; the candidate stops before executing that forecast.

The rear-left hip is at its lower force cap in 90/150 post-prefix native samples, including 85 with positive velocity. Its instantaneous public command envelope has identical lower and upper torque in 90 samples.

Across 55 overlapping best forecasts, the rear-left hip has identical torque throughout its instantaneous interval envelope in 17136/18135 steps. This local fixed-state accounting does not establish global infeasibility.

Only the initial command-60 contact forecast predicts positive front-right force: 15 samples in its final three intervals. All other 54 best forecasts have zero. Those late predicted samples are beyond the retained candidate native duration.

The selected command-90 forecast first violates the rear-left hip position margin at interval 65, internal offset 0, before a joint-limit constraint appears. Later rows contain three rear-left hip limit constraints. Both front feet have zero load throughout this forecast.

All 150 matched first-interval native steps preserve distal contact presence relative to their forecasts. Position, velocity and force differences remain diagnostic measurements; later intervals are not native validated.

Later actual baseline commands differ from held forecast baselines. The 741 prepared and 689 transferred comparisons overlap and follow the actual closed loop; they do not supply counterfactual baseline truth or identify the cause of forecast error.
claim_limits: All original native accept/reject decisions, controllers, caps, guards, horizons, samplers, seeds and receipts are unchanged.

All 5262 retained candidate outcome fields are summarized; complete candidate guard/cost reconstruction is inherited from the native parent readers. New scalar/vector motor and guard arithmetic covers all 55 nested best forecasts.
Prepared support flags, geometric contact, positive normal force and capsule clearance are distinct. A positive force count does not qualify sustained support or recovery.
The 18135 predicted steps belong to overlapping retained forecasts, not additional independent physical observations.
Instantaneous torque envelopes hold each retained state fixed and do not compute alternative trajectories.
A complete twelve-second recovery comparison, safe withdrawal, training-data authority, learned Tier 2, beneficial Tier 3, real-time performance, equivalence and release remain unqualified.
